Versions of Ozymandias include:
  • Ozymandias draft manuscript (circa 1817)
  • "Ozymandias", in The Examiner (1818)
  • "Sonnet. Ozymandias", in Rosalind and Helen, A Modern Eclogue (1819)
  • "Ozymandias of Egypt", in Poems That Every Child Should Know (1904), edited by Mary Elizabeth Burt
  • "Ozymandias" in The Hundred Best Poems (lyrical) in the English language (1904), edited by Adam Luke Gowans
  • "Ozymandias", in The Complete Poetical Works of Percy Bysshe Shelley (1914), edited by Thomas Hutchinson
  • "Ozymandias" in Weird Tales, 8 (3) (September 1926) edited by Farnsworth Wright
